title: In test mode, a real gym owner who pays with a test card gets a real paid plan and a real receipt
what: Buying a MettleUp plan online only works with the payment company's test keys today. But the payment it takes is treated like real money: the gym's paid-until date moves on, the plan changes, and a numbered MettleUp receipt is made. The owner's billing screen and receipt never say test mode. The switch that opens Pay online is one switch for every gym, so turning it on to try it with the test gym opens it for every gym, and any owner could get a year of Pro with a test card.
expected: While payments are in test mode, a test payment should not give a real gym real paid time or a real receipt number, and the owner's screen should say test mode; or Pay online should open only for the test gym.
how_often: only if the Pay online switch is turned on while payments are in test mode
fix_line: Mark test payments as test (no paid time, no numbered receipt), or open Pay online per gym for testing

title: An owner whose payment could not become a plan is told nothing
what: When the payment company takes the owner's money but it cannot become a plan (the amount was not what was asked, or the gym changed in between, for example it went Pro for life on another link), the money is kept for MettleUp to refund or set by hand. The owner's billing screen still shows the old plan and end date, no receipt, and no word that the payment arrived and is being checked. Only the MettleUp office list shows it.
expected: The owner's billing screen should say that a payment arrived, that it could not be applied yet, that MettleUp will refund it or set the plan, and what happened once it is done.
how_often: rare: only when a paid link cannot be applied
fix_line: Show held payments and their outcome on the owner's billing screen

title: Moving from Starter up to Pro costs more than the price difference
what: The move-up price is the monthly difference divided by 30 (or the yearly one by 365), times the days left counting today. A paid month runs from today to the same date next month, which is 31 days counted that way (a year is 366). So an owner who pays Starter monthly and moves up the same day pays Rs 517, not Rs 500, and Rs 1,516 in all, more than Pro's Rs 1,499. On yearly the move-up is Rs 5,013, not Rs 4,999. The refund page says you pay only the difference for the days left.
expected: Moving up should never cost more than the price difference, and Starter plus a move-up should never cost more than buying Pro.
fix_line: Cap the move-up at the full price difference, or count the days the same way the paid month does

title: Test-mode payments are announced to members and gyms as real
what: Member payment requests and payments made while payments are still in test mode (no real money) go out like real ones. A member gets a phone pop-up saying their gym asked them to pay their fee, tap to pay. The gym's alert bell says the member paid online, see it on Money. Neither says test mode, though each payment request knows whether it was test or live.
expected: A test-mode request should not pop up on a real member's phone, and a test-mode payment's alert should say it was a test with no real money.
how_often: every payment request or payment while payments are in test mode
fix_line: Pass test or live with each request and skip the member pop-up, or say test, for test ones
